```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (
    is.logical(x)
  ) {
    return(
      replace(
        x,
        is.na(x),
        FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  if (
    is.numeric(x)
  ) {
    return(
      !is.na(x) &
        x != 0
    )
  }

  tolower(
    trimws(
      as.character(x)
    )
  ) %in%
    c(
      "true",
      "t",
      "1",
      "yes",
      "y"
    )
}


check_file <- function(
    file,
    description
) {
  if (
    !file.exists(
      file
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      description,
      " not found:\n",
      file
    )
  }
}


read_stability <- function(
    file,
    dataset
) {
  check_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      dataset,
      " stability file"
    )
  )

  x <- read.csv(
    file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required <- c(
    "Contrast",
    "Gene",
    params$
      stability_flag_column
  )

  missing <- setdiff(
    required,
    names(
      x
    )
  )

  if (
    length(
      missing
    ) > 0
  ) {
    stop(
      dataset,
      " stability file is missing: ",
      paste(
        missing,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  x %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Contrast =
        as.character(
          Contrast
        ),

      Gene =
        trimws(
          as.character(
            Gene
          )
        ),

      bootstrap_stable =
        as_flag(
          .data[[
            params$
              stability_flag_column
          ]]
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      Contrast,
      Gene,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )
}


read_de_with_stability <- function(
    de_dir,
    stability,
    source_contrast,
    flip_logfc = FALSE
) {
  file <- file.path(
    de_dir,
    paste0(
      source_contrast,
      ".csv"
    )
  )

  check_file(
    file,
    paste0(
      "DE result for ",
      source_contrast
    )
  )

  de <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(
      "Gene"
    ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required <- c(
    "Gene",
    "logFC",
    "FDR"
  )

  missing <- setdiff(
    required,
    names(
      de
    )
  )

  if (
    length(
      missing
    ) > 0
  ) {
    stop(
      basename(
        file
      ),
      " is missing: ",
      paste(
        missing,
        collapse = ", "
      )
    )
  }

  stability_sub <- stability %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Contrast ==
        source_contrast
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Gene,
      bootstrap_stable
    )

  if (
    nrow(
      stability_sub
    ) == 0
  ) {
    stop(
      "No bootstrap-stability entries found for contrast ",
      source_contrast
    )
  }

  de <- de %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Gene =
        trimws(
          as.character(
            Gene
          )
        ),

      logFC =
        as.numeric(
          logFC
        ),

      FDR =
        as.numeric(
          FDR
        )
    )

  if (
    flip_logfc
  ) {
    de <- de %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        logFC =
          -logFC
      )
  }

  de %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      stability_sub,
      by =
        "Gene"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bootstrap_stable =
        dplyr::coalesce(
          bootstrap_stable,
          FALSE
        ),

      FDR_significant =
        !is.na(
          FDR
        ) &
        FDR <=
        params$
          fdr_cutoff,

      stable_significant =
        FDR_significant &
        bootstrap_stable
    )
}
```

```{r}
build_shared_stable <- function(
    source_contrast,
    display_comparison,
    flip_logfc = FALSE
) {
  crc <- read_de_with_stability(
    de_dir =
      params$
        crc_de_dir,

    stability =
      crc_stability,

    source_contrast =
      source_contrast,

    flip_logfc =
      flip_logfc
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      stable_significant
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Gene,
      CRC_logFC =
        logFC,
      CRC_FDR =
        FDR
    )

  ucec <- read_de_with_stability(
    de_dir =
      params$
        ucec_de_dir,

    stability =
      ucec_stability,

    source_contrast =
      source_contrast,

    flip_logfc =
      flip_logfc
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      stable_significant
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Gene,
      UCEC_logFC =
        logFC,
      UCEC_FDR =
        FDR
    )

  dplyr::inner_join(
    crc,
    ucec,
    by =
      "Gene"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      consistent =
        (
          CRC_logFC >
            0 &
          UCEC_logFC >
            0
        ) |
        (
          CRC_logFC <
            0 &
          UCEC_logFC <
            0
        ),

      direction =
        dplyr::case_when(
          CRC_logFC >
            0 &
          UCEC_logFC >
            0 ~
            "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

          CRC_logFC <
            0 &
          UCEC_logFC <
            0 ~
            "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

          TRUE ~
            "Inconsistent"
        ),

      comparison =
        display_comparison
    )
}


shared_mssl <- build_shared_stable(

  flip_logfc =
```

```{r}
safe_gost_gscs <- function(
    genes,
    direction,
    comparison
) {
  genes <- unique(
    na.omit(
      trimws(
        as.character(
          genes
        )
      )
    )
  )

  genes <- genes[
    nzchar(
      genes
    )
  ]

  if (
    length(
      genes
    ) <
      3
  ) {
    warning(
      comparison,
      " / ",
      direction,
      ": fewer than 3 genes; enrichment skipped."
    )

    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  message(
    "g:Profiler: ",
    comparison,
    " | ",
    direction,
    " | n = ",
    length(
      genes
    )
  )

  result <- tryCatch(
    gprofiler2::gost(
      query =
        genes,

      organism =
        "hsapiens",

      sources =
        params$
          sources,

      significant =
        TRUE,

      correction_method =
        "g_SCS",

      evcodes =
        TRUE
    ),

    error =
      function(e) {
        warning(
          "g:Profiler failed: ",
          conditionMessage(
            e
          )
        )

        NULL
      }
  )

  if (
    is.null(
      result
    ) ||
    is.null(
      result$
        result
    ) ||
    nrow(
      result$
        result
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  result$
    result %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(
        p_value
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      comparison =
        comparison,

      direction =
        direction,

      query_size =
        length(
          genes
        ),

      neglog10_p =
        -log10(
          pmax(
            p_value,
            1e-300
          )
        )
    )
}


run_directional_gscs <- function(
    shared_df,
    comparison
) {
  consistent <- shared_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      consistent
    )

  up_genes <- consistent %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      direction ==
        "Up in MSS/TMB-H"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      Gene
    ) %>%
    unique()

  down_genes <- consistent %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      direction ==
        "Down in MSS/TMB-H"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      Gene
    ) %>%
    unique()

  up_result <- safe_gost_gscs(
    genes =
      up_genes,

    direction =
      "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

    comparison =
      comparison
  )

  down_result <- safe_gost_gscs(
    genes =
      down_genes,

    direction =
      "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

    comparison =
      comparison
  )

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    up_result,
    down_result
  )
}
```

```{r}
flatten_list_columns <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(
        where(is.list),
        ~ vapply(
          .x,
          function(z) {
            if (
              is.null(z) ||
              length(z) == 0
            ) {
              return("")
            }

            paste(
              as.character(z),
              collapse = "; "
            )
          },
          character(1)
        )
      )
    )
}

enrichment_mssl_export <- flatten_list_columns(
```

```{r}
select_plot_terms <- function(
    enrichment_df
) {
  if (
    nrow(
      enrichment_df
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  enrichment_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      direction,
      source
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      p_value,
      .by_group =
        TRUE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(
      n =
        params$
          top_n_per_source
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%

    
    
    dplyr::mutate(
      term_label =
        paste0(
          source,
          ": ",
          stringr::str_trunc(
            term_name,
            width =
              params$
                term_label_width
          )
        )
    )
}


enrichment_mssl_plot <- select_plot_terms(
  enrichment_mssl_all
)


enrichment_msih_plot <- select_plot_terms(
  enrichment_msih_all
)

write.csv(
  flatten_list_columns(
    enrichment_mssl_plot
  ),
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "gSCS_plotted_terms_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  flatten_list_columns(
    enrichment_msih_plot
  ),
  file.path(
    table_dir,
    "gSCS_plotted_terms_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSI_H.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
plot_directional_enrichment <- function(
    df,
    title,
    subtitle,
    output_stub
) {
  if (
    nrow(
      df
    ) ==
      0
  ) {
    warning(
      title,
      ": no significant g:SCS enrichment to plot."
    )

    return(
      NULL
    )
  }

  direction_levels <- c(
    "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
    "Down in MSS/TMB-H"
  )

  
  
  
  term_order <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction =
        factor(
          direction,
          levels =
            direction_levels
        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      direction,
      p_value
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      term_label
    ) %>%
    unique()

  plot_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction =
        factor(
          direction,
          levels =
            direction_levels
        ),

      term_label =
        factor(
          term_label,
          levels =
            rev(
              term_order
            )
        )
    )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x =
        direction,
      y =
        term_label
    )
  ) +

    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(
        size =
          intersection_size,

        color =
          neglog10_p
      ),
      alpha =
        0.95
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_color_gradient(
      low =
        "#56B4E9",

      high =
        "#E66101"
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(
      range =
        c(
          2.5,
          8.5
        ),

      breaks =
        scales::pretty_breaks(
          n =
            5
        ),

      name =
        "Gene count"
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title =
        title,

      subtitle =
        subtitle,

      x =
        NULL,

      y =
        NULL,

      color =
        expression(
          -log[10](
            "g:SCS p"
          )
        )
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_classic(
      base_size =
        12
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face =
            "bold",
          hjust =
            0.5,
          size =
            14
        ),

      plot.subtitle =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          hjust =
            0.5,
          size =
            11
        ),

      axis.text.x =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face =
            "bold",
          size =
            11
        ),

      axis.text.y =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size =
            10
        ),

      axis.title =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        "right",

      legend.box =
        "vertical",

      plot.margin =
        ggplot2::margin(
          10,
          15,
          10,
          10
        )
    )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0(
          output_stub,
          ".svg"
        )
      ),

    plot =
      p,

    width =
      8.5,

    height =
      max(
        6,
        0.31 *
          nlevels(
            plot_df$
              term_label
          ) +
          2.5
      ),

    device =
      "svg"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename =
      file.path(
        plot_dir,
        paste0(
          output_stub,
          ".pdf"
        )
      ),

    plot =
      p,

    width =
      8.5,

    height =
      max(
        6,
        0.31 *
          nlevels(
            plot_df$
              term_label
          ) +
          2.5
      ),

    device =
      grDevices::
        cairo_pdf
  )

  p
}
```
